DamageDef.label: water pressure
DamageDef.description: Blunt water-pressure injury used by Water and Glacial techniques. Weapon-derived power, the selected technique and any consumed Pressure determine the requested impact; armor and defensive effects then reduce it. Eligible Ascendant injury packets receive the common 20% damage reduction. Frost visuals and freeze ticks do not continuously repeat the attack.

HediffDef.label: Pressure
HediffDef.description: Marked by a Water Ascendant's successful strike. Up to three stacks per caster, refreshed for eight seconds. Only the strongest caster's mark affects movement: 5% per stack, at most 15%. Ocean's Judgement can consume its caster's stacks for a stronger primary impact.
